svg.title: S08_disease_therapy_similarity
svg.desc: Jaccard similarity of distinct Therapy neighbours for 134 Diseases; 0 empty-neighbour diseases excluded and listed. PRE_TREATED_BY, TREATED_BY and POST_TREATED_BY are pooled only for this declared similarity projection. Average linkage orders rows; indices map to full labels/RIDs in CSV. Neighbourhood similarity is not clinical similarity.
